title: Card
lead: Get started with the card component to show content in a box such as titles, descriptions, and images based on multiple styles and sizes built with React

examples.name: Card with custom image render function
examples.axis: Card with custom image render function

prose.text:
The card component can be used to show a wide variety of content such as previews of blog posts, user profiles, pricing plans, and more. Choose from one of the many examples built with React and the utility classes from Tailwind CSS.

To start using the card component you will need to import it from `flowbite-react`:

prose.title: Default card
prose.text: Use this example to show a simple card component with a title and description and apply the `href` tag to the `<Card>` component to set a hyperlink to the card.

prose.title: Card with CTA button
prose.text: By also importing the `<Button>` component you can add it inside the card to show a call to action button.

prose.title: Card with image
prose.text: Add an image to the card by using the `imgSrc` prop and set the `imgAlt` prop to add an alt text to the image.

prose.title: Card with custom image render function
prose.text:
Specify your own render function for the image component for the card by using the `renderImage` prop. This is especially useful when
using the component with NextJS or Gatsby.

prose.title: Horizontal card
prose.text: Use the `horizontal` prop to show the card in a horizontal layout.

prose.title: User profile card
prose.text: Use this example to show a user card with a profile picture, name, job title, buttons and a dropdown menu.

prose.title: Card with form
prose.text: You can also add form elements inside of the card component such as for sign up or login forms.

prose.title: E-commerce card
prose.text: Use this example to show a product card with an image (product preview), title, price, rating stars and buttons built for E-commerce websites.

prose.title: CTA card
prose.text: Use this component to display a call to action card for mobile applications where you feature download buttons for App Store and Google Play.

prose.title: Card with list
prose.text: Use this component to display a card with a list of items such as your latest customers or latest orders that include an image, descriptive text and a link to view more.

prose.title: Pricing card
prose.text: Use the pricing card component to show the pricing of your product or service.

prose.title: Crypto card (web3)
prose.text: This component can be used for crypto and web3 related projects where you can choose which wallet you want to connect with (ie. Metamask, Coinbase).

prose.title: Theme
prose.text: To learn more about how to customize the appearance of components, please see the [Theme docs](/docs/customize/theme).
